instruction: Create a single-page SVG close-up of a person holding a smartphone in one hand. Make the hand-phone interaction the focal point: fingers must convincingly wrap around and support the device, with visible thumb placement, joints, nails, screen edge, camera or speaker details, and reflected light. Use a cropped editorial composition, natural skin and device shading, and a subtle background. Put strong emphasis on believable anatomy, contact points, depth, and polished illustrative craft.
